articles.title: Malawi tightens border screening, imposes quarantine rules to prevent Ebola
articles.description: LILONGWE, Nov. 21 (Xinhua) -- The Malawian government, through the Ministry of Health and Sanitation, has issued a travel advisory alongside enhanced surveillance and public health measures to prevent the importation of Ebola virus disease from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The measures were announced in an official communication on Friday and signed by Secretary for Health and Sanitation Dan Namar
